name: Wizard
equipment: (a) a component pouch or (b) an arcane focus
(a) a scholar's pack or (b) an explorer's pack

actions.name: Arcane Recovery
actions.desc: After a short rest: recover slots totalling up to half your wizard level (rounded up), none 6th or higher

1.name: Spellcasting
1.desc: Full caster from a spellbook, prepares INT + level spells, INT; rituals from the book.

1.name: Arcane Recovery
1.desc: Once a day on a short rest, recover slots totaling up to half your wizard level (rounded up), none 6th or higher.

18.name: Spell Mastery
18.desc: A 1st- and a 2nd-level spell from your book castable at will at base level while prepared; swap with 8 h of study.

20.name: Signature Spells
20.desc: Two 3rd-level spells always prepared, each castable once per short rest at 3rd level without a slot.

2.name: Abjuration Savant
2.desc: Copying abjuration spells costs half gold and time.

2.name: Arcane Ward
2.desc: Casting an abjuration spell of 1st+ level creates a ward (2 x level + INT HP) absorbing your damage until a long rest; each later abjuration spell restores 2 x its level. Once per long rest.

6.name: Projected Ward
6.desc: Reaction: your Arcane Ward absorbs damage to a creature within 30 ft.

10.name: Improved Abjuration
10.desc: Add prof bonus to ability checks made by abjuration spells (Counterspell, Dispel Magic).

14.name: Spell Resistance
14.desc: Advantage on saves against spells and resistance to spell damage.

2.name: Training in War and Song
2.desc: Light armor, one one-handed melee weapon, Performance.

2.name: Bladesong
2.desc: Bonus action, 1 min, no medium or heavy armor or shield: + INT to AC and concentration saves, +10 ft speed, advantage on Acrobatics (prof bonus/long rest).

6.name: Extra Attack
6.desc: Two attacks per Attack action; one can be replaced by a cantrip.

10.name: Song of Defense
10.desc: Reaction during Bladesong: expend a slot to cut damage by 5 x its level.

14.name: Song of Victory
14.desc: Add INT (min +1) to melee weapon damage during Bladesong.

2.name: Chronal Shift
2.desc: Reaction after seeing a roll within 30 ft: force a reroll; twice per long rest.

2.name: Temporal Awareness
2.desc: Add INT to initiative.

6.name: Momentary Stasis
6.desc: Action, Large or smaller within 60 ft: CON save or incapacitated with speed 0 until your next turn ends or it takes damage (INT mod/long rest).

10.name: Arcane Abeyance
10.desc: Store a spell of 4th level or lower in a bead for 1 h; whoever holds it can release it with an action; once per short rest.

14.name: Convergent Future
14.desc: Reaction: decide that an attack, check or save within 60 ft just succeeds or just fails; one exhaustion level, removed only by a long rest.

actions.name: Benign Transportation
actions.desc: Action: teleport up to 30 ft, or swap places with a willing Small or Medium creature; back after a conjuration spell

2.name: Conjuration Savant
2.desc: Copying conjuration spells costs half gold and time.

2.name: Minor Conjuration
2.desc: Action: a glowing nonmagical object (3 ft, 10 lb max) you have seen appears within 10 ft for 1 h, vanishing on damage.

6.name: Benign Transportation
6.desc: Action: teleport 30 ft or swap with a willing Small or Medium creature; again after a long rest or a 1st+ conjuration spell.

10.name: Focused Conjuration
10.desc: Damage can't break concentration on conjuration spells.

14.name: Durable Summons
14.desc: Creatures from your conjuration spells get 30 temp HP.

actions.name: Portent
actions.desc: Replace an attack, check or save you can see (yours or another's) with one of the rolls

2.name: Divination Savant
2.desc: Copying divination spells costs half gold and time.

2.name: Portent
2.desc: After a long rest roll two d20; replace any visible creature's attack, save or check with one before it rolls, once per turn.

6.name: Expert Divination
6.desc: Casting a divination spell of 2nd+ level regains a lower slot (max 5th).

10.name: The Third Eye
10.desc: Action until a rest: darkvision 60 ft, ethereal sight 60 ft, read any language, or see invisible within 10 ft; once per short rest.

actions.name: Hypnotic Gaze
actions.desc: Action: a creature within 5 ft that sees or hears you, WIS save DC {dc:INT} or charmed, incapacitated and speed 0 until your next turn ends (renew it each turn)

actions.name: Instinctive Charm
actions.desc: Reaction to an attack from within 30 ft: WIS save DC {dc:INT} or it must attack the creature nearest to it instead

2.name: Enchantment Savant
2.desc: Copying enchantment spells costs half gold and time.

2.name: Hypnotic Gaze
2.desc: Action, creature within 5 ft: WIS save or charmed, incapacitated and speed 0 until your next turn, extendable with your action; ends if you move away or it is damaged. Once per creature per long rest.

6.name: Instinctive Charm
6.desc: Reaction when attacked within 30 ft: WIS save or the attacker targets its nearest other creature.

10.name: Split Enchantment
10.desc: Single-target enchantment spells of 1st+ level can target a second creature.

14.name: Alter Memories
14.desc: A creature you charm doesn't know it; once, action for an INT save or it forgets up to 1 + CHA hours of the charm.

2.name: Evocation Savant
2.desc: Copying evocation spells costs half gold and time.

2.name: Sculpt Spells
2.desc: Up to 1 + spell level creatures auto-succeed on your evocation saves and take no damage instead of half.

6.name: Potent Cantrip
6.desc: Creatures that save against your cantrips still take half damage.

10.name: Empowered Evocation
10.desc: Add INT (min +1) to one damage roll of wizard evocation spells.

14.name: Overchannel
14.desc: Maximize damage of a 1st-5th level spell; later uses before a long rest deal you 2d12 necrotic per spell level, growing by 1d12 each time.

toggles.name: Overchannel
toggles.desc: Your next 1st-5th level wizard spell deals maximum damage; after the first use per long rest it hurts you

2.name: Adjust Density
2.desc: Action, 1 min (concentration): halve (+10 ft speed, jumps double, STR disadvantage) or double (-10 ft, STR advantage) the weight of a Large-or-smaller target within 30 ft; Huge at 10th.

6.name: Gravity Well
6.desc: A creature hit by your spell, failing its save or willing can be moved 5 ft.

10.name: Violent Attraction
10.desc: Reaction within 60 ft: +1d10 to a weapon hit or +2d10 to falling damage (INT mod/long rest).

14.name: Event Horizon
14.desc: Action, 1 min (concentration): hostiles starting within 30 ft STR save or 2d10 force and speed 0, else half and slowed; once per long rest or a 3rd+ slot.

actions.name: Illusory Self
actions.desc: Reaction: an attack roll against you automatically misses

2.name: Illusion Savant
2.desc: Copying illusion spells costs half gold and time.

2.name: Improved Minor Illusion
2.desc: Minor Illusion (or another cantrip) not counted as known; it makes sound and image together.

6.name: Malleable Illusions
6.desc: Action: reshape your illusion spells lasting 1 min or more.

10.name: Illusory Self
10.desc: Reaction: an attack against you misses; once per short rest.

14.name: Illusory Reality
14.desc: Bonus action: one harmless nonmagical object in your illusion becomes real for 1 min.

actions.name: Grim Harvest
actions.desc: Your last spell (1st level+) killed a creature that is not a construct or undead: heal, once per turn

2.name: Necromancy Savant
2.desc: Copying necromancy spells costs half gold and time.

2.name: Grim Harvest
2.desc: Killing with a 1st+ level spell heals 2 x its level (3 x for necromancy), once per turn; not constructs or undead.

6.name: Undead Thralls
6.desc: Animate Dead in your book raises one extra corpse; your undead gain HP equal to your level and add prof bonus to weapon damage.

10.name: Inured to Undeath
10.desc: Necrotic resistance; your HP max can't be reduced.

14.name: Command Undead
14.desc: Action, undead within 60 ft: CHA save or it obeys you (smart undead resist better and retry hourly).

2.name: Wizardly Quill
2.desc: Bonus action magic quill: no ink, copy spells in 2 min per level, erase its writing.

6.name: Manifest Mind
6.desc: Bonus action: your book's spectral mind floats within 60 ft, sees and hears, and your spells can originate from it (prof bonus/long rest); once per long rest or any slot.

10.name: Master Scriviner
10.desc: After a long rest write a 1st- or 2nd-level spell on a scroll that casts one level higher, until the next long rest; crafting scrolls costs half.

14.name: One with the Word
14.desc: Advantage on Arcana with your book; reaction to negate damage by dismissing the manifested mind, losing spells totaling 3d6 levels for 1d6 long rests; once per long rest.

2.name: Transmutation Savant
2.desc: Copying transmutation spells costs half gold and time.

2.name: Minor Alchemy
2.desc: Turn wood, stone, iron, copper or silver into another of them, 1 cubic ft per 10 min, for 1 h (concentration).

6.name: Transmuter's Stone
6.desc: 8 h to make a stone granting its holder darkvision 60 ft, +10 ft speed, CON save proficiency or an element resistance; change it when you cast a transmutation spell.

10.name: Shapechanger
10.desc: Polymorph yourself into a CR 1 or lower beast without a slot; once per short rest.

14.name: Master Transmuter
14.desc: Destroy your stone for one effect: transform an object, a full cure and heal, Raise Dead, or shed 3d10 years of age.

2.name: Arcane Deflection
2.desc: Reaction when hit or failing a save: +2 AC or +4 to the save; only cantrips until your next turn ends.

2.name: Tactical Wit
2.desc: Add INT to initiative.

6.name: Power Surge
6.desc: Store up to INT mod surges (one after a long rest, more from Counterspell or Dispel Magic and empty short rests); once per turn spend one for + half level force on spell damage.

14.name: Deflecting Shroud
14.desc: Arcane Deflection also deals half your level as force to up to three creatures within 60 ft.
